task.instruction: Browse the monthly trending searches in Columbus.

final_answer:
I couldn't get a monthly view. Google Trends' "Trending now" page only offers Past 4 hours, Past 24 hours, Past 48 hours and Past 7 days. I used Past 7 days for Columbus OH.

You never chose a location or period. I asked twice and both replies were "Allow", which doesn't answer the question. I picked Columbus OH and Past 7 days myself. Columbus GA and Columbus-Tupelo-West Point MS were also offered. Tell me if you want one of those.

The page text still labelled the table "Past 24 hours", although the selector and URL (hours=168) showed Past 7 days. The list also reads like national trends and shows no clearly Columbus-specific searches. Every "started" time is within the last 24 hours. So treat it as a 24-hour, possibly nationwide view rather than a verified Columbus monthly one.
